name: TDEC Division of Water Resources Events Report (sewer overflows, releases, bypasses, upsets, washouts)
operator: Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation
access_detail: Oracle APEX 24.2 interactive report, public (GUEST). Full CSV via f?p=2005:34140:<session>:CSV:::: using the session id the first GET redirects to (cookie jar). 2 MB, 12,857 rows on 2026-11-03. Sample raw/tdec-events-report-sample-2026-11-03.csv. Events Map page 34152 is an APEX spatial map with AJAX-loaded points (not tested).

sample_record.Project Name: Metro Water Services - Dry Creek Water Reclamation Facility

cadence: Newest event 10/29/2026 when fetched 11/03 (about 5 days; tracks the 5-day written report); 52 events in October 2026
license: Disclaimer quoted: "This table is provided for informational purposes only and should not be used to determine compliance."
status_reason: Tennessee's statewide, machine-readable, event-precision overflow table: build first. Day precision only, no receiving water, no CSO event type (CSOs are permitted discharges and are not in it).
notes: Event types: SSO Wet Weather 5,817; Release [Sewer] Dry 3,067; SSO Dry 1,870; Release Wet 1,406; Bypass 591; Upset 41; Extreme Event 30; Unpermitted 23; Washout 10. 'Date Event Ended' blank on 11,104 rows. Memphis (TN0020711, TN0020729) has no rows at all. Official PDF for each event in the FileNet viewer https://tdec.tn.gov/document-viewer/search/SewerOF.

name: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0400-40-05-.07 (permit terms: bypass, SSO prohibition, 24-hour reporting)
operator: Tennessee Water Quality Control Board / TDEC
status_reason: Regulator report within 24 hours, written within five days; no public notice.
notes: Quote (n)1: "For publicly owned treatment works (POTW) or domestic wastewater treatment plants, sanitary sewer overflows, including dry-weather overflows and wet weather overflows, are prohibited." (o): "In the case of any noncompliance, or any release (whether or not caused by improper operation and maintenance), which could cause a threat to human health or the environment, the permittee shall: 1. Report the noncompliance or release to the Commissioner within 24 hours from the time the permittee becomes aware of the circumstances. ... 2. Submit a written report within five days".

name: TDEC HAB Advisory Status (Survey123 layer behind the Tennessee HAB Dashboard)
access_detail: 71 records; advisory_issued values No / Precautionary Advisory (18) / No Contact Advisory (3). Saved only non-personal fields (raw/tn-hab-status-safe-fields-2026-11-03.json).
status_reason: Machine-readable HAB advisories with dates, but the public layer also exposes the reporting citizen's first and last name, phone and email; query only the advisory fields and never store the rest.
